format.note: Event manifest for task 35 (devin-work/audio). 'events' are transient stems placed at film time t; 'gain_db' is trim ON TOP of mix.py STEM_GAIN defaults (coin 1.0, coin-slot 0.45, cloth 0.7, washer 0.8). 'beds' are sustained layers spanning [from_s,to_s]. Types use mix.py vocabulary; 'washer-spin'/'washer-tail' beds are rendered by task 35's own mixer (crossfade stem_washer motor texture, attack removed). No footsteps anywhere. All times are film seconds on the finished picture timeline devin-work/picture/jessica.json.
